description: Source code for rpmsg backend implementation in Zephyr OS, handling shared memory, virtqueue setup, and inter-processor messaging.

methods.name: ipc_virtio_get_status
methods.description: Retrieves the status of the virtio device, returning DRIVER_OK if master, otherwise reads from hardware.

methods.name: ipc_virtio_set_status
methods.description: Sets the status of the virtio device by writing to hardware.

methods.name: ipc_virtio_get_features
methods.description: Returns the features supported by the virtio device, specifically the namespace feature.

methods.name: ipc_virtio_set_features
methods.description: Stub function for setting features, no implementation.

methods.name: ipc_virtio_notify
methods.description: Notifies the other side via IPM, depending on support configuration.

methods.name: ipm_callback_process
methods.description: Processes IPM callback by notifying the virtqueue.

methods.name: ipm_callback
methods.description: Handles IPM callback, submits work to process the notification.

methods.name: rpmsg_backend_init
methods.description: Initializes the rpmsg backend, setting up shared memory, virtqueues, IPM, and device roles.

methods.name: init_status_flag
methods.description: Clears the status flag early in system initialization.
